stages.name: reflect_padded clone (>=min dims)
stages.notes: clone_shallow() does a real Vec clone when dims >= min(8); pad path only for smaller inputs

stages.name: u8->linear LUT
stages.notes: LINEAR_LUT_U8 gather per channel-sample; bg/alpha unused

stages.name: 6x 2x2 downsample (incl. tail)
stages.notes: (p00+p01+p10+p11)*0.25; 4 edge min()-clamps per elem; loop always downsamples after last scored level

stages.name: linear->XYB cbrt
stages.notes: opsin 9 fma + 3x cube_root_and_add (mul13 fma6 add4 int5 cmp1) + make_positive; swe's per-channel internals adopted — my earlier ~mul45/add20 undercounted

stages.name: 15 blur jobs h pass (IIR 4-unroll interior)
stages.notes: 15 plane-jobs = 5 quantities x 3ch. Interior per elem: 2 gathers (product jobs +1.2 load +0.6 mul), 1 sum add, 3 coeff iters x (1 mul + avg 3.5 fma), 2 combine adds, 1 store.

stages.name: 15 blur jobs v pass
stages.notes: vertical IIR: per elem 2 gathers (+product 0.6 mul +1.2 ld), sum add, 3 terms x (2 fma + neg), combine adds, store.

stages.name: ssim maps + norm
stages.notes: adopted swe's richer decomposition (f32 quotient + f64 accum + edge norm); matches maps.rs loop structure

stages.name: scale norms + 108-weight sum + transform
stages.notes: 3ch x 6scales x 2norms x 3 terms (score_walk); scale_norm sqrt/div folded in; final poly + powf
